As Raw MicrobiomeR Format

Source: R/metacoder-formatting.R
as_raw_format.Rd

Converts a Taxmap object to the raw_format.

as_raw_format(obj)

Arguments

obj

An object to be converted to a Taxmap object with create_taxmap.

Value

A Taxmap object in the "raw_format".

Details

See the MicrobiomeR_Formats documentation.

See also

is_phyloseq_format, is_raw_format, order_metacoder_data @importFrom crayon silver red green
